2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.

8:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;

21:   const bullets = [];

23:   const fuels = [];

25:   // ---------- helper functions ----------
26:   const rand = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
27:   const distance = (a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
28: 
29:   function spawnAsteroid() {
30:     const edge = Math.floor(rand(0, 4));
31:     const pos = { x: 0, y: 0 };
32:     switch (edge) {
33:       case 0: pos.x = 0; pos.y = rand(0, height); break; // left

35:       case 2: pos.x = rand(0, width); pos.y = 0; break; // top

50:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.code] = false);
51: 
52:   // ---------- game loop ----------
53:   let last = performance.now();
54:   let asteroidTimer = 0;
55:   let fuelTimer = 0;
56:   let gameOver = false;
57:   let startTime = performance.now();
58: 
59:   function update(dt) {
60:     if (gameOver) return;
61:     // ship control
62:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.angle -= 3 * dt;
63:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.angle += 3 * dt;
64:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] && ship.fuel > 0) {
65:       const thrust = 0.1;
66:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * thrust;
67:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * thrust;
68:       ship.fuel -= dt * 5; // fuel consumption
69:     }
70:     // shoot
71:     if (keys['Space']) {
72:       if (!ship._lastShot || performance.now() - ship._lastShot > 200) {
73:         bullets.push({ x: ship.x, y: ship.y, vx: Math.cos(ship.angle) * 5, vy: Math.sin(ship.angle) * 5, ttl: 1000 });
74:         ship._lastShot = performance.now();
75:       }

77:     // update ship position

97:
